title: Circular supersession (malformed)
brief: Create docs/architecture/decision-099-circular-a.md with supersedes: docs/architecture/decision-099-circular-b.md, and docs/architecture/decision-099-circular-b.md with supersedes: docs/architecture/decision-099-circular-a.md. This creates a cycle A→B→A.
why_malformed: Supersession must be a DAG; a cycle makes history non-navigable and must be rejected.
